purpose.zh: 练腹部核心，提升躯干控制
purpose.en: Build core strength and trunk control.

text.zh: 下背压实地面，肩胛离地
text.en: Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulder blades

text.zh: 手臂贴耳伸直，双腿并拢伸直
text.en: Keep your arms straight by your ears and your legs straight together.

text.zh: 手和腿离地越低越难，以腰不离地为准
text.en: The lower your arms and legs, the harder it gets; keep your back down.

commonErrors.en: Letting the lower back arch off the floor.

cautions.zh: 全程保持腰部贴地，腰部发紧或疼痛时减小幅度
cautions.en: Keep your lower back down; reduce the range if it feels tight or painful.
